edition.headline: Buyers Chase Plank, Up 36%
edition.dek: From 30 Strands to 41: sellers name their price
edition.lead: Plank closed the day at a mean of 41 Strands, against 30 the day before. 120 units changed hands at the Exchange, and the floor wanted more. Those holding stock may find this a good week to sell; those who need it may wish they had bought on Marketday.
edition.weather: Mist on the moat at dawn, burnt off by mid-morning. Sunrise at six, sunset at eighteen; lamps in the urban windows from seven.
edition.markets: 37 trades at the Exchange today, 6,300 Strands in all, across three goods. The busiest was Plant Fiber, with 900 units at a mean of 1. Plank rose most, 36% to 41.
edition.best_sale_story: The finest goods sold today: one Iron Axe of quality 91 (grade A), at 410 Strands each, sold by Ada.
edition.deeds_story: Four new deeds recorded and one lost to unpaid tax: one claimed and one foreclosed in the Suburban Zone; three claimed in the Rural Zone.
edition.producers_story: A trader who keeps out of the papers made the most today: 500 units, chiefly Logs (500). The next two made 360 between them.
